statement: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle. Proves that the Thorp shuffle randomizes $`N=2^d`$ labeled cards in $`\Theta(\log N)`$ physical shuffles, settling its optimal mixing order for power-of-two deck sizes. Convergence is in total variation from the worst initial ordering and concerns the entire permutation, not just individual card positions.
